regressions.what: Shopfronts became cream light boxes: street-level glass went from grey (112-142) to (195-208), now the brightest large surface in both street views and a flat card with no depth. facade.js line 182 raised the shop day gain to 0.9*lampC*(1.1+2.0*uNight), and line 193 uses transK 0.85 for shops, over pale room walls (rBack 0.55, rSide 0.62). The r5 fix asked for 0.45.

A pedestrian walks through the camera near-field in the opening frame: the man in the blue singlet, 1.5-2.5 m from the lens, is cropped by the bottom edge, is bigger than the player and overlaps the player box (x 0.27-0.40). In hero_night he fills x 0.08-0.31 and is the dominant figure. No camera keep-out in peds.js.

Draw-call creep from the new crowds: hero_night 848 -> 1771 (+109%), hero_noon 842 -> 1187 (+41%), river_cbd 1683 -> 2118 (+26%), kings_park 578 -> 763 and tris 7.1M -> 9.7M, street_sgt 437 -> 527 with no visible gain. About 80 Rocketbox characters across the zones are visible to 340 m from the player, and they draw into the shadow and mirror passes. phone_hud calls are flat (418 -> 421), still above 400.

Night spawn plaza is now lit evenly with no visible source: ghost lamps light the paving but have no pole or bollard, so the pool reads as a flood fill rather than lamp light (better than black, but a new 'light from nowhere' tell).

fixes.area: empty St Georges Tce (peds + traffic do not reach the CBD camera)
fixes.problem: street_sgt still has 0 cars and 0 people; shops has 1 parked car. The code is in place (LOOPS.sgt, T.prime) but it never shows up. (1) peds.js S.update hides every ped with d2p > 340 m from the PLAYER (vis = d2p < 340). For camLocked views the player stays at EQ (112,-168), and the street_sgt camera is about 528 m away, so all 12 sgt walkers are invisible. In play the same rule thins any street the camera looks down beyond 340 m. (2) T.prime picks a random lane and a random point on it 400 times. The 20-160 m forward half-disc is about 0.5% of the network area, so roughly 2 of the 11 wanted cars land. (3) 12 walkers on a 1.34 km loop is about 1 per 110 m, far below a CBD footpath.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.update: const fo = G.camLocked && G.focus ? G.focus : {x:px, z:pz}; use the distance to fo for the vis test, and keep the player distance only for flee and avoidance logic. Add S.prime(fo, camPos, camFwd): move sgt and eq walkers to loop waypoints 15-140 m from fo with dot(p-cam, fwd) > 0 (call it next to traffic.prime in shoot.mjs and on teleport). Recycle: every 1 s, a walker more than 220 m from fo jumps to a random waypoint 60-180 m away that is outside the view cone. traffic.js: precompute samples every 10 m along each usable lane, [x,z,h,li,d], once at create. T.prime filters those to 20-160 m and forward, shuffles, and places with the existing 14 m spacing until 0.6*target. sgt population on high 12 -> 24, low 5 -> 8.

PRIME_SAMPLER: 10 m lane samples filtered to band

fixes.problem: street_sgt and shops: the glazed bays are flat cream (198,184,163) / (195,182,165), up from grey 112-142 in r4, and are now the brightest large area in both frames. They are the nearest architecture. The interior is pale walls (rBack 0.55, rSide 0.62, rCeil 0.6) times 0.9*(1.1+2.0*uNight), transmitted at 0.85. It reads as a backlit sheet, not a shop.
fixes.fix: facade.js line 182: shop gain 0.9*lampC*(1.1+2.0*uNight) to 0.9*lampC*(0.35+2.6*uNight). Line 193: shop transK 0.85 to 0.6. Line 196: shop gl *= 0.6 to 0.8, so the street and sky reflect by day. Shop rooms (after line 179): rBack = mix(vec3(0.16,0.15,0.14), vec3(0.42,0.38,0.33), step(0.5, fract(hp.y*1.6))) for shelving bands, rSide *0.45, and a 1.1 m high counter/merch block 1.5 m inside the glass (a second ttz plane at depth 1.5 for hp.y < 1.1, albedo 0.12-0.3 by signC). Keep the night gain.

fixes.problem: hero / hero_noon / hero_night: a walker 1.5-2.5 m from the lens is cropped by the frame bottom, bigger than the player, and overlaps the player's left side. In hero_night he is the main figure. The 'landing' and 'eq' loops spawn and walk through the 4.4 m camera boom.
fixes.fix: peds.js add(): reject spawn points within 8 m of PLAYER spawn whose dot with the camera back-vector is > 0 (re-roll on the loop). S.update: compute the camera position each frame; if a walking ped is within 3.0 m of it, add a lateral steer away (yaw += sign*1.2*dt) and cap speed at 0.6. character.js: dither-fade (material alphaHash with opacity = smoothstep(0.6, 1.6, distToCamera)) so the rare intruder dissolves instead of filling the lens, like GTA.

fixes.area: night plaza: light without a source, flat pools

The lamp map is 4 m per texel (box 4100 m over N=1024) with sigma 6 m, so pools merge into a wash. It stays under the bridge sightline and gives the pool a source. Lamp map: N 1024 -> 2048 (2 m texels, 4 MB R8) and sig 6.0 -> 4.5; bollards splat with sig 2.5 at 0.7 strength. daycycle.js line 124: uCharFill 0.20*uNight -> 0.08*uNight, so the lamp map shapes the people.
